thread:
Sam: Quick delivery snapshot — hitting the end-of-week milestone. Quant recs v0.3 merged, batching config draft in PR #234, cache-policy prototype pushed to staging. Owners: Priya (quant), Jon (runtime), Elena (deploy).

Priya: Thanks — small heads-up, v0.3 changed the default quantization schema. We ran a smoke eval on the regression harness: most prompts look fine but got a 2.7% BLEU-ish drop on long-seq tests.

Jon: Saw the drop. I ran perf traces — KV cache hits improved, p99 latency down ~8ms, but tail quality dips on >1k tokens. Suspect packing + quantization combo.

Elena: Can we get a minimal repro? I need it to validate rollout gating with infra. Also, is Dedicated affected?

Priya: Repro is in the repo under `optkit/evals/long_seq`. Quick command: ```bash
python run_eval.py --suite long_seq --model rec-v0.3 --shots 0
```
Results and diffs attached in the repo. Dedicated runs the same code path; profiles differ slightly due to batch packing.

Carla: infra note — autoscaler change in CL 5127 will be applied tonight to staging. That may change effective batch sizes during the run, so please pin `max_batch=8` in staging tests to keep results stable. Ticket #5127.

Priya: Good call. I've pushed a temp override to PR #234: `max_batch: 8`. Also adding a regression-alert rule in Optimize so we get notified if eval delta > 2%.

Jon: I'll add a runtime guard that detects quant + packing path and falls back to fallback-quant (v0.2) if quality loss > threshold during A/B canary. Simple flag: `--enable-quant-guard`.

Sam: Reviewers needed for PR #234 (batching config) and the runtime guard change. @Priya can you review the quant PR? @Jon do you want a quick CR on the runtime guard?

Priya: I can review the quant PR today. Focus on the schema and unit tests.

Jon: I'll open the runtime PR shortly, assign to Elena and Sam for deploy implications.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: optkit/staging -> canary-1 at 2134567930. Monitoring traces and SLI.

Elena: Watching the canary. If we see >1% regression on long_seq in the next 30m, I'll rollback and escalate. Also need sign-off on Dedicated rollout plan before next Thursday.

Carla: FYI infra change CL 5127 scheduled to complete at 2134568100. I'll post when it's live.

Sam: Action items: (1) Priya review quant PR, (2) Jon open runtime guard PR, (3) Elena monitor canary and hold rollback threshold, (4) Carla confirm infra rollout. I'll update the delivery runbook and ping owners in #eng-ml after infra is live. :thumbsup:

Priya: note — added a short checklist in the PR description for backcompat tests and eval hooks.

Jon: PR opened: runtime/PR#410, includes `--enable-quant-guard` and a small perf test. Assigning to Elena + Sam.

Sam: thanks all — short async check. If anyone sees a blocker, call it out here and I'll escalate.

Elena: No blockers right now. Monitoring looks clean at minute 10. :white_check_mark:

Priya: I'll post regression diffs in the PR shortly.

Carla: Infra change applied to staging (CL 5127) at 2134567955. Confirmed pinned batch behavior for the tests.

Sam: Perfect — will close the loop once Priya posts diffs and Elena gives final canary green.
